<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical experimental tolerance is C₁₀H₁₀O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H10O5</final_answer>
